title.zh: Why Circle is spending $400M to fix the last mile holding stablecoins back from real-world payouts
title.en: Why Circle is spending $400M to fix the last mile holding stablecoins back from real-world payouts

current_state.zh: Circle agreed to acquire cross-border payments firm Tazapay for $400 million in stock to add local banking, licensing, currency conversion, and fiat payout rails across 100+ markets, closing the off-ramp gap that prevents stablecoins from completing real-world payments.
